rust_summary: the open world's level name and the default worlds' folder names mapped to their dimensions (`native_level_name`, `native_dimension_of_world`, `native_world_of_dimension`).
doc_summary: `native_level_name()` is the open world's folder name, the `level-name` of server.properties on a dedicated server (None with no world open). `native_dimension_of_world(name)` and `native_world_of_dimension(id)` map `world`, `world_nether` and `world_the_end` to `minecraft:overworld`, `minecraft:the_nether` and `minecraft:the_end`, both ways; any other name maps to None. API @API:level_name@.
